name: Horde Intervention: a Horde Supplies crate destroys once, not on every click (COA-10409)
contract: Quest 175150 needs 7 of 16 Horde Supplies crates (GO 2300709) destroyed. The crate was a pure native GOOBER with autoCloseTime and consumable both 0, so nothing stopped a single crate from being spam-clicked for the whole objective. It now carries SmartGameObjectAI with an On Use force-despawn on the next update (respawn per the spawn table's 60 s): one use credits once and removes the crate; the next life (after its own respawn) credits again. A 1 s despawn delay kept the crate clickable, with native credit on every click, for that second.
